notes: v0.33.0 — task execution primitive. Executes a plan of capability invocations in sequence, persisting state to the graph at each step. Supports $prev and $intent substitution in step input. Budget enforced per step; on exhaustion, state=handoff. Artifacts extracted from any *_path/*_base64/path/artifact_path field on step outputs. On step failure, state=failed and step_index stays at the failing step for resume. $prev does not survive process restarts (step outputs are in-memory).
